facts: The reservation branch requires a live caller. Shared authentication, halt/killswitch, kiosk and receipt gates are separate wrapper obligations; this facet closes only reservation/item authority.

Item lookup trims the submitted slug, scans work_items then work_items_archive, and matches the exact slug; it never resolves an old opaque ID to a new name. Archived items remain eligible for this metadata access.

Visibility is USER, the stored owner or creator node, a strict ancestor of owner (or creator while unowned), an explicit participant, or the named reviewer. Stored actor objects resolve by node string here; this is the legacy rule, not a claim of born-identity fencing.

Ancestry reads parent links from the anchor toward USER with a cycle guard. Org visibility alone grants no docket access. The item owner/creator/reviewer, participants, and necessary parent links are the predicate read set.

The reservation adapter converts both missing and unreadable item lookup to false; its refusal is identical for either. Naming a resource permits only the contention projection of HELD rows, never item-read or mutation authority.

Renew/release/land require exact reservation ownership, not merely item visibility. Recover of a HELD claim instead checks stored lease/heartbeat and owner liveness, and returns only contention metadata to an unrelated caller.

A release successor must be live and able to read a nonempty associated item. These checks are necessary but not sufficient: post_mail also enforces addressing, and its refusal must roll back the entire release.
Public dispatch adds caller/authentication and operation-receipt admission/replay reads beyond the reservation rows.
Source sets below describe domain predicates, not physical SQL/table contacts.
open_questions: Resolve the complete dispatch/authentication/receipt/sidecar read set against P02 contacts.

facts: Both public reservation names are TX_POST for every action, including domain-read list/landing/overlap.
Original-key operation receipt/log writes must be distinguished from reservation-domain writes.
The public boundary fixtures demonstrate that a keyed domain-read call can append a receipt without changing reservations; physical storage contacts and save fanout remain for P02.
open_questions: Pin actual success/refusal publication, receipt and diagnostic writes in the public wrapper.

facts: Current document helper relies on its caller holding DOC_LOCK for load/mutate/save.
Target conflict sets must preserve predicates without replacing DOC_LOCK by a mandatory global row.
Shared-resource and original integration-key conflicts differ from physical engine waits.
open_questions: Choose and qualify indexed native predicates/isolation for each variant, including the retained-512-row admission cap.

facts: action = str(args.get('action') or '').strip().lower(); the alias reaches the identical adapter.
_safe and _contention are separate allowlisted result projections; no arbitrary args echoed.
Declared paths normalize slash runs/trailing separators without resolving or opening paths.
Selector fixtures exercise dispatch conditions only; complete result/error/default wire fixtures remain required.

reservation-boundary.json pins full fresh top-level and nested reservation field sets for all eleven variants and both aliases; public API tests compare these sets and semantic values, rather than only selecting a branch.

Current canonical action normalization, finite lease defaults/bounds, path separator deduplication, absent/null distinctions, text-container refusal, privacy projections, rollback and keyed receipt shapes are executable boundary fixtures.

Scalar coercion is asymmetric: candidate is an API text key but base/resource/item/successor are helper-normalized. Equal helper meaning is not automatically equal keyed fingerprint. Full malformed numeric/container and all shared wrapper refusals remain outside this tranche.
open_questions: Complete malformed numeric/container and shared-wrapper result/refusal parity beyond the reviewed boundary fixtures; carry native and Rust versions through the same cases.

facts: This specifies the current legacy reservation receipt contract. Native original-key custody/exact-result retention and runtime proof remain separate unqualified v6 work; no current receipt is represented as a complete saved response.

Both aliases and every action are transaction+post. A bare unkeyed call files no operation receipt. A keyed call must use orgtree_op_call with inner tool/args/key/epoch; envelope key fields, missing epoch, and nested receipt verbs refuse before dispatch.

Admission occurs within write_org, after caller existence/halt/killswitch checks but before reservation predicates. A retained same-key replay therefore bypasses current reservation state/item predicates. Current authentication still runs before this point; native disclosure revalidation is not claimed to exist in this legacy branch.

Fingerprint is full SHA256 of canonical tool/node/generation/normalized args. Tool aliases are distinct identities. Admission normalizes only the API text-key set first; the helper later strips/lowers action, so action spelling variants can select the same domain operation yet conflict under one key.

Admission checks key syntax, custody epoch and key age before looking for a retained row. A retained different fingerprint conflicts; a matching fence or foreign generation refuses; otherwise the row replays. Only an absent row reaches the newer-schema and eviction-watermark refusals. Receipts are found across generations and classified at their original generation and fingerprint subject.

Accepted replay returns exactly replayed/op_id/at/tool/outcome/receipt/status, not the original result and not a second helper call, save or wake. It does not repeat a post-commit effect whose prior outcome is unknown.

Immediately before save, the API appends an applied receipt in the same org transaction as reservation state and any release mail/audience changes. Refusal or a pre-commit save exception leaves none durable. The process sequence witness advances after save while the lock remains held.

The stored result is a scalar allowlist plus restricted reservation/overlap rows, capped at 128 list entries; created/updated/heartbeat timestamps, stale reasons, contention view tags and arbitrary data are omitted. Landing-query rows and stale-ID lists are not retained; count may describe more rows than the slice stores.

Post-effects list drive for this receipt class and observed is the literal unknown, even for domain-read actions. Release carrier delivery is added only after filing and saving, so it is absent from the receipt result.

Receipt schema/coverage are 1; keys permit 60-second future skew. More than 500 rows trim to 400 and raise from_ms strictly beyond the greatest evicted mint, never lower it. Retained matching rows can replay even below this watermark while epoch/age/generation checks hold; the watermark guards admission only when the row is absent.

Lookup classifies a retained row before answering. A current-epoch absent eligible reservation key is durably fenced and returns not_applied; its delayed original refuses. Under an old epoch, a matching applied row is positive evidence, but an absent row is unknown and no new fence is written. No lookup/custody classification permits executing an absent old key after uncertain restore.
This reservation helper only mutates its supplied document; no filesystem/process/network action is executed.
Outer dispatch receipt/diagnostic contacts are a separate unresolved obligation.
On first successful release with a successor, the adapter posts status mail, emits mail_notify and stages a wake unless deferred.
The mail body contains reservation ID and release receipt; retry of RELEASED returns notified:null.
Target behavior uses source Sent authority/effects and receiver-owned acceptance; it is not one atomic A-to-B transaction.
open_questions: Close post_mail's transitive authority/reply-grant effects and staged receiver/effect contacts.

facts: Declare domain changes separately from actual database/connection/receipt/log/effect contacts.
A pre-storage refusal must record zero contacts; a whole-operation claim needs every causal continuation.
No runtime census or native transaction was executed by this static registry.
open_questions: Bind actual connection/statement and callback probes with loss accounting in P02; test hidden contact and mail-locality controls.

No reservation-row mutation when both candidate and base are null/absent.
Unfiltered list cannot become a directory of private claims; explicit-resource visibility widening never grants mutation authority.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read matching visible rows and candidate/base, state, expires_ts, heartbeat_ts, stored stale_s.
May mark mismatched eligible nonterminal rows STALE and update reason/timestamps; return changed IDs.
Either non-null candidate or base requires BOTH valid SHAs; a HELD row with unexpired lease OR active heartbeat is protected.
Actual affected set can span resources when resource is absent; never force ordinary list through this widest set.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read LANDED visible rows for the required item.
No reservation-row mutation.
If no visible results and item callback denies, refuse with hidden/nonexistent indistinguishability.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read optional item authority; all retained integration-key rows, row count, same-resource HELD claims and holder liveness.
Replay matching authorized key or own same-scope unexpired claim; otherwise recover/stale eligible prior claims and insert HELD.
Integration-key resource/scope mismatch refuses before row admission; key never grants authority.
Retained row count >=512 refuses, INCLUDING terminal rows, before same-owner ordinary replay; keyed replay precedes this cap.
Recovery requires quiet heartbeat AND (expired lease OR holder not live); scope change does not bypass it.
Paths <=128, length <=512; resource <=200; item <=96; positive bounded lease/stale <=86400. Preserve source truthy-default semantics.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read same visible item rows, optional matching resource and normalized declared path prefixes.
No reservation-row mutation or filesystem access.
Require item visibility; paths are comparison metadata and never grant access.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read exact reservation owner/state and bounded lease.
Update expiry/heartbeat/update timestamps of the exact HELD row.
Only owner; state must be HELD; lease positive and <=86400; source truthy-default behavior preserved.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read exact row state, expires_ts, heartbeat_ts, stored stale_s and owner liveness; separate full versus contention projection.
Mark RECOVERED and record recovering actor/reason/update timestamps.
A HELD shared claim can be recovered without item visibility, but quiet heartbeat AND expired lease or non-live holder are still required.
Caller-supplied shorter stale_s never replaces the recorded threshold. Hidden result exposes contention projection only.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read exact fully visible row state, candidate/base, expiry/heartbeat/stored stale_s.
Terminal row replays; eligible HELD row becomes STALE.
HELD requires changed candidate/base AND expired lease AND quiet heartbeat; no authority widening from resource naming.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read exact owner/state and normalize absent/empty successor.
Mark HELD as RELEASED, store opaque release_receipt and timestamps, successor null.
Only owner; RELEASED replays with notified:null; LANDED and other terminal states refuse.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read exact owner/state, successor liveness and successor item visibility.
First HELD release stores RELEASED, receipt, successor, timestamps; adapter adds mail and possible authority effects.
Successor must be live and authorized for the associated item; empty-item successor is refused by adapter.
RELEASED replay returns notified:null without a second mail.
Use the action's visibility/owner/recovery gates before returning its allowed projection.
Read exact owner/state, requested-or-recorded candidate/base and matching integration-key rows.
Mark HELD as LANDED and store integration receipt/key/landed/update times; existing LANDED replays.

Candidate mismatch marks the temporary helper row stale then raises. The public API returns 422 and the next write and cold reload retain the original HELD row; the boundary fixture proves discard after refusal.
Another same-key LANDED row replays; other same-key states refuse. This is a report of Git landing, not a Git command.

This facet specifies legacy read-material authorization, not native Effective fencing. Both tools call the same _agent_read_access before reading content; shared middleware/transport and operator/bridge paths remain separately unresolved.

The public agent path authenticates org/node/generation, requires a live unreplaced caller, and checks halt/killswitch before these reads. The tool-specific read then obtains a seq-guarded cached org, without a document transaction around content production.

Self wins first; strict descendant ancestry wins second, even for an archived target. Otherwise the shared-item route checks the active work_items collection, current holder/reviewer/participant standing, and the target node name in the holder roster except its last row. Creator, org visibility and unrelated-item membership do not independently grant material access.

The item access disclosure includes via,item,title,standing,held_from,derived,note. Stored holder rows survive history folding. An absent roster is derived from surviving assign history/current owner without persisting it.

Once a route authorizes the target, the adapter exposes that target scratch namespace or bounded transcript; it does not filter returned content by work-item tags. The item is an authorization witness, not a content selector. Any finer native content policy requires an explicit design/product ruling.

Legacy limits must remain visible: work_items is a storage-placement test, not status!=done; a done item still in that collection can grant until archive. A returning current holder also appearing earlier in its roster can match. _work_actor_node extracts the node string without checking born or generation, despite roster rows carrying born. These are source observations, not approved native permissions.

Membership is recomputed for the next call after a saved removal/archive. The legacy implementation does not revalidate while file/transcript content is being produced, and does not acquire an output claim. A successful initial check therefore is not proof that a later restriction became Effective safely.

Read predicates are authenticated caller liveness/generation and runtime halt state; self identity or the target parent chain; otherwise active item membership, current role, and previous roster membership. Content is reached only after _agent_read_access returns.

Legacy item matching searches active items in stored order and takes the latest matching target in each prior roster. The first granting item supplies the disclosure; full-org active-item scans are existing cost, not a native query plan.

The native contract must close authorization with the disclosed output and immutable identity using the approved affected-consumer fence. No source-bound assertion here authorizes a global read lock or repeats legacy name-only/returning-holder holes.

Both tools are classified NONE and return before the public document receipt admission/save path. An accepted orgtree_op_call envelope is unwrapped but these reads file no applied receipt, perform no original-key replay, and reevaluate authority/content on every retry.

The wrapper still refuses envelope op_key/op_epoch, missing inner key/args, missing epoch and nested receipt verbs. A present read key is not admitted against epoch/key syntax by these early-return branches. A current-epoch lookup without an applied receipt reports unknown/unsupported_operation and creates no fence.
No-receipt is not no-write: filesystem creation and transcript/reply sidecar writes can occur. Idempotency, current-disclosure and native/Rust conformance remain subject to their own gates.

The read door consults cached org snapshots for caller/halt/target/item/ancestry. Scratch resolves an OS realpath beneath the shared lineage scratch root, checks isdir/isfile, enumerates the whole directory before a 200-name slice, or reads the whole UTF-8 replacement-decoded file before a 20000-character slice.

scratch_dir additionally checks disk placement through sandbox.on_disk (which can load org state) and can reload org data on directory creation. Disk-backed UNC resolution, sandbox ownership, storage-pool/cache misses and every transitive helper are not an exhaustive contact map yet.

read_chat calls chat_window.read_window and unique_cards. The current transcript stack consults provider files, prompt/import sidecars, retained transcript records, projection cache, assistant state, runtime state and reply snapshots. The bounded fixture witnesses three SQLite surfaces; it does not enumerate every provider/import/sandbox branch.
open_questions: Complete the transitive/provider/import/sandbox and cache-hit/miss contact census, including all file reads and document accesses, before P02 closes this facet.

facts: The early API branch has no explicit org save or operation receipt, but a cold transcript helper mints reply/transcript incarnation identifiers under DOC_LOCK and saves the org. The shared snapshot is not stamped, so the same call can repeat reply-incarnation save cycles before the next fresh snapshot. Warm pre-minted fixture reads avoid these org saves; neither case files an operation receipt.

scratch_dir creates a missing lineage directory and attempts sandbox ownership repair, with exceptions swallowed. No atomic transaction couples that directory or ownership attempt to the earlier read authorization.

Transcript reads can initialize/write transcript-records.sqlite3, chat-window-index.sqlite3 and reply-events.sqlite3 in separate SQLite connections and transactions, independently of the cold org identity saves. Ingestion/retained quote data is not automatically disposable projection data. Runtime caches can also change.
open_questions: Complete physical write/effect coverage and native placement for every transitive branch; no cross-database atomicity has been established.

facts: No org-wide DOC_LOCK spans these tools from authority to response. Cold identity mints do individually take DOC_LOCK and save; snapshot publication, transcript SQLite transactions and runtime locks have their own boundaries. Those boundaries do not make authorization plus disclosure atomic.

Plain transcript calls wait on a four-reader per-event-loop limiter before executing their fresh agent identity/state checks. The legacy route recognizes the plain tool name; an OP_CALL-wrapped read uses the general worker path. Neither path grants a durable output fence.
Native conversion must use the approved narrow authorization/output protocol, current immutable identities and bounded indexed item lookups, and must prove disjoint reads/writers remain independent.
open_questions: Implement and qualify Effective restriction races, recycled identities, returning current-holder exclusion and bounded native predicates; retain explicit legacy/native differences rather than copying defects.

facts: These tool branches do not intentionally send mail or start a provider. Scratch may create directories and call sandbox chown_agent; for sandboxed orgs that helper invokes Docker chown. This test package spies that effect and never starts a container.
Transcript reads can lazily import durable records, persist quote identities, update derived caches/order and volatile runtime state. The source name read must not hide these effects.
open_questions: Inventory all conditional helpers and external effects with P02 probes; retain failure/recovery outcomes rather than claiming exactly-once from these fixtures.

facts: The local tool adapter shapes are executable in material-read-boundary.json and tests/test_state_material_reads.py. Scratch returns dir/access/entries, file/access/content, or error/access (missing path is HTTP200); path escape and text-container errors are HTTP422 detail. OS errors are not converted to missing-path success.

Transcript returns node,busy,access,occupancy,occupancy_estimated,messages. Each projected message retains only role,text,tools, truncates text to 1200 characters, defaults absent tools to [], and preserves an explicit tools:null. The outer last slice remains even when read_chat supplies extra rows.

last defaults to30 for missing/null/empty, coerces through int then float-to-int, and clamps to1..80; malformed or nonfinite values return422. node/path use shared text normalization: null restores default, scalars stringify, containers refuse. The card schema is stricter than the gateway coercion.

The scratch path is stripped, leading separators removed, then realpath-resolved with a separator-anchored containment check. Its 20000/200/1200 bounds constrain returned characters or entries, not underlying IO or all nested response bytes.
open_questions: Full provider/projector, middleware/operator/bridge/error serializer and Rust/native wire parity remain unqualified; selected adapter fixtures do not close those branches.

facts: Fixture-only sqlite3 connection/statement observation identifies actual sidecar reads/writes and separate commits for one synthetic local transcript. It records no production data and does not enable runtime census.

Production profiling/contact logging must still label operation identity, exact physical/logical surfaces, read/write/predicate modes, transaction membership, atomicity/lock domains and waits with the approved privacy/overhead controls.
open_questions: Implement P02 complete runtime instrumentation and drift/unknown-contact refusal, then native concurrency/negative controls; fixture observations are neither a full census nor conversion authorization.

limits: Every static entry/dispatch/connection witness is accounted for; pending is not semantic coverage.
The first mapped family has eleven reservation variants; its transitive/native/wire/contact gaps remain explicit.
Registration sites are not a runtime operation denominator.
Source assertions and selector checks do not establish public result parity, native isolation or actual atomicity.

The reservation boundary suite executes the current public API against disposable SQLite state with provider wakes replaced by spies. It is legacy conformance evidence, not a live census or PostgreSQL/Rust qualification.
Paired material-read fixtures pin legacy authenticated behavior and expose known native differences. Sidecar observations are synthetic and incomplete; no runtime-census or conversion gate is passed.
